title: VIRGIN GALACTIC UNVEILS SPACESHIP APEIRON
body_markdown:
**VIRGIN GALACTIC UNVEILS SPACESHIP** ***APEIRON***


***Selected by voters from more than 80 countries across six continents. Apeiron, the ancient Greek word for “the boundless,” reflects the spirit of exploration at the heart of Virgin Galactic’s mission. Apeiron is slated to fly to Spaceport America today ahead of flight test preparations.***


MESA, Ariz. -- Virgin Galactic (NYSE: SPCE) today announced the name of its new Spaceship will be *Apeiron* (A'-per-on). Drawn from the ancient Greek concept of the boundless, *Apeiron* embodies the infinite possibilities that spaceflight brings to each of us individually and all of us collectively.


The name was chosen by a public vote that drew thousands of responses from around the world. This included 83 countries and six continents, giving the global space community a direct role in shaping the identity of the company’s lead Spaceship.


“ *Apeiron* , the Boundless, captures the ambition of human spaceflight and the possibilities it opens for humanity. The extraordinary response to the public vote made choosing this name even more meaningful. We’re proud that the lead ship in Virgin Galactic’s Spaceship fleet will carry a name chosen by the people who share our excitement for what comes next,” said Michael Colglazier, Chief Executive Officer of Virgin Galactic.


Later today, Spaceship *Apeiron* is slated to fly to Spaceport America in New Mexico mated to launch vehicle Eve. There, Virgin Galactic’s engineering team plans to complete avionics software validation before beginning flight tests. The company expects to provide additional program updates during its third quarter 2026 earnings call in November.


**About Virgin Galactic**


Virgin Galactic is dedicated to expanding the boundaries of human possibility. Through its spaceflight expeditions, the company offers people a profound new perspective on our planet and their own potential, while enabling scientific discovery and supporting strategic government missions. Virgin Galactic combines world-class aerospace engineering with thoughtfully designed astronaut experiences and a scalable spaceline operating model. Its reusable, air-launched Spaceships are designed to make spaceflight safe, repeatable, operationally efficient, and increasingly accessible, advancing a long-term vision of opening space to millions for extraordinary purposes. Learn more at[www.virgingalactic.com](http://www.virgingalactic.com/) .
